changes: p2 (Kā++ka): removed 'commissioner'. The colophon only says the book is for his reading and study (pāthapustakasvādhyārthena), which makes him the owner. Nothing says he had it made.

p3 (Jajanu): moved 'dānapati' from titles into the role 'donor' (titles now empty). Added a note that 'jajanu' is probably a corrupt or truncated 'jajamāna' (yajamāna, 'patron') rather than a personal name.
purpose: replaced the raw quote with a short paraphrase.
date: added the completion phrase to as_written. Checked ce_approx: Āśvina is the last month of NS 1001, so it falls in 1881.

date.as_written: śubhasambat 1001 chi sāla miti āśunakṛṣṇa nhu 7 nhusaḥ sidhaye ka jula

purpose: for the reading and study of Vajrācārya Kā++ka; given as a religious gift (deyadharma)
notes: The owner's name has a two-akṣara lacuna (śrīkā++kasya). 'dānapati jajanu' at the end may not be a personal name. It is probably a corrupt or truncated 'jajamāna' (Skt. yajamāna, 'patron'), so it would mean 'the donor-patron' with no name given. It is kept as a low-confidence person. The donor may also be the commissioner, but the colophon doesn't say so. The note that the copy was written on gold leaf (suvarṇṇapatre) is a feature of the copy and is not recorded as a place. The catalogue fields (scribe Ratnamāna, NS 1001) agree with the colophon.
